operations.name: footage.replace
operations.description: Relink a footage item to a different file (FootageItem.replace). Layers using the item keep keyframes/effects. Pass sequence=true to relink to an image sequence.

params.name: path
params.description: Absolute path to the new file

params.name: sequence
params.description: Treat path as the first file of an image sequence (default false)

params.name: forceAlphabetical
params.description: Sequence only: force alphabetical order (default false)

operations.name: footage.interpret
operations.description: Set footage interpretation: alpha mode, frame rate conform, looping, fields, pixel aspect (FootageItem.mainSource).

params.name: conformFrameRate
params.description: Conform to this frame rate (0 = native)

params.name: loop
params.description: Number of times to loop the footage

operations.name: footage.reload
operations.description: Reload a footage item from its source file (FileSource.reload) — picks up external edits to the file without relinking.

operations.name: footage.list_missing
operations.description: List footage items whose source file is missing (footageMissing), with the last-known path. The footage counterpart of font.list_missing.

operations.name: footage.replace_with_solid
operations.description: Replace a footage item's source with a solid color (FootageItem.replaceWithSolid). Layers using the item keep keyframes/effects.

operations.name: footage.replace_with_placeholder
operations.description: Replace a footage item's source with a placeholder (FootageItem.replaceWithPlaceholder) — e.g. to stand in for footage that will arrive later. Layers keep keyframes/effects.

operations.name: footage.set_proxy
operations.description: Set or clear a proxy on any project item (comp or footage): a file, an image sequence, a solid color, or a placeholder. Omit path/solidColor/placeholder to remove the proxy.

params.name: path
params.description: Absolute path to the proxy file — omit to remove the proxy

params.name: sequence
params.description: Treat path as the first file of an image sequence (default false)

params.name: solidColor
params.description: [r,g,b] 0-1 — set a solid proxy instead of a file (setProxyWithSolid)

params.name: placeholder
params.description: Set a placeholder proxy sized like the item (setProxyWithPlaceholder)
